Batter Up.name: Batter Up
Batter Up.summary: Batter Up is a baseball game for one or two players. It features a fictional "Namco League" consisting of 14 teams, each with their own player roster, with different players having their own strengths and weaknesses.

Ristar.name: Ristar
Ristar.summary: 8-bit port of Ristar on the Sega Game Gear with remixed levels and a few original stages.
